purpose: Resolve and Shadow-validate the existing zhongshu Core Feishu control contract on the installed OpenClaw 2026.7.1 without touching production.
allowed_operations: read-only inspection of installed OpenClaw help, schema, source, and local state projections
offline or Shadow-only process lifecycle tests on non-production ports
offline patch, idempotence, rollback, and redaction tests
prohibited_actions: read or modify the two user-protected scope paths
print or persist complete OpenClaw configuration or any Secret
modify production configuration, Binding, Agent, Cron, OAuth, model, or PROJECT_STATUS.yaml
stop or restart the production Gateway or Core Feishu Binding
connect to real Feishu or perform real RPC authentication
rollback: Shadow artifacts are isolated under experiments/core_feishu_control_contract and can be removed only in a separately authorized cleanup; production state has no mutation path in this task.
secrets: Only structural fields, hashes, counts, abstract statuses, and Fake-token markers are allowed in artifacts; raw identifiers, endpoints, paths outside the approved Shadow root, and credential values are forbidden.
